shared_elements: upright rectangular carved slab/pillar with rounded top edge
row of arch- or loop-shaped motifs in an upper register
row of small bird-like figures in profile below the band
adjacent plain block in the foreground
justification: Both show a tall pale slab bearing the same sequence from top down 	a row of three arch/loop motifs, a horizontal dividing band, then a register of profile bird-like figures over a zigzag/net field 	set amid identical-looking excavation rubble with a plain block intruding at the lower foreground. The only real difference is viewpoint and framing: A is a raking close-up that resolves the disc, snake-like form and handled object, while B is a more distant, foreshortened view showing the whole shaft and its base, so the lower motifs are barely legible.
